data.name: Suganya
data.gender_notes: Suganya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Suganya means 'granting desires, pleasing'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su-kanya', where 'su' means 'good' and 'kanya' means 'maiden'. It is also the name of a goddess in Hinduism, who is believed to fulfill the desires of her devotees. The name Suganya carries the meaning “Granting Desires, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Suganya usually hope their child will grow to embody granting desires, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine grace and blessings of the gods, and the ability to fulfill one's desires and bring happiness and pleasure to others.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Suganya also holds great spiritual significance as it is the name of a goddess in Hinduism. This goddess is believed to be the embodiment of goodness and pleasure, and is often depicted with a lotus in her hands, symbolizing purity and divinity. The name signifies the ultimate attainment of spiritual fulfillment and desire for the divine.
